target: at least one valid recorded purchase in [cutoff, cutoff + 30 days)
risk_set: identified customers with at least one valid purchase strictly before cutoff
evaluation_cutoffs: each monthly cutoff with at least six earlier cutoff cohorts whose 30-day labels are complete by evaluation cutoff
training_rule: expanding window; include only episodes where training cutoff + 30 days <= evaluation cutoff
model: median imputation, standard scaling, LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=500,random_state=20260729); no tuning
stability_summaries: standardized coefficient sign consistency and range
negative_control: within-training-cutoff label permutation, refit at every evaluation cutoff using the frozen seed
interpretation_rule: Call a pattern temporally stable only descriptively when PR-AUC gain is positive in at least 80% of evaluation cutoffs and the key coefficient sign is unchanged in at least 80%; report calibration and cohort exceptions. No causal or hidden-holdout claim.
